consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was solid, with standout moments in several songs. While some found the show laid back, many appreciated the heartfelt playing and unique blends in the setlist.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 19 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many enjoyed the performance, the overall consensus noted that it was not the strongest of the three-night run, leading to a slightly positive sentiment.
